lipidsText.paCharge: Net charge at pH 7: phosphatidylethanolamine 0, phosphatidylcholine 0, phosphatidylserine −1, phosphatidylglycerol −1, cardiolipin −2, phosphatidic acid −1*, PIP2 −4*. (*Lehninger’s values. A phosphate monoester is only partly ionized on its second —OH at pH 7: phosphatidic acid is counted as −1, and in PIP2 the phosphodiester is −1 and each ring phosphate about −1.5.)
